All operations are transparent and aligned with standard AUR packaging practices.

The package depends only on `glibc`, a fundamental system library, and declares appropriate `provides` and `conflicts` for clean integration. The installed files are limited to the binary, license, and documentation—typical for a minimal utility. No post-install hooks or system modifications are performed.
